name: record-replay
description: 在本地 Edge 中录制浏览器操作并回放，保存操作结构和参数占位符，不保存输入值或访问地址。支持导入工作流、超时取消和执行报告。

interface.shortDescription: Record and replay locally with Playwright and Edge
interface.longDescription: Use an audited foreground command to record an external Edge browser, normalize imported workflows to k-Coder browser tools, and run bounded local replays with JSON reports. Recordings remain workspace files and are not exposed through a dedicated panel.
defaultPrompt: Record my local browser workflow with parameterized inputs
